bulletins.title: Pitch 3 Aeration & Drainage Maintenance - Weekend Relocations
bulletins.content: Due to scheduled aeration and irrigation maintenance, Memorial Park Field 3 (West) will be closed for all weekend games on April 11-12, 2026. All U10 Girls Rec matches originally slated for Field 3 have been reassigned to Field 2 (Turf). Please review updated kickoff times on your team schedule.
bulletins.author: League Operations

bulletins.title: Spring Season Kickoff & Parent Sideline Etiquette
bulletins.content: Welcome to the Spring 2026 Youth Soccer season! We are thrilled to welcome over 400 players and families. Please remember that coaches and parents must remain on opposite touchlines. Spectator noise and cheering must remain positive and encouraging at all times. Referees have complete authority over match conduct.
bulletins.author: Executive Committee

bulletins.title: Referee Match Report Submission Deadline & Match Cards
bulletins.content: Center referees are reminded to submit digital match cards via the portal within 24 hours of final whistle. In case of yellow or red cards, please include a detailed incident note in the match card remarks section.
bulletins.author: Referee Coordinator

bulletins.title: Inclement Weather & Rainout Protocol
bulletins.content: In the event of heavy rain or lightning warnings, the league safety officer will inspect pitches by 7:00 AM on game days. Status updates will be posted immediately to this bulletin board and sent via team coach text broadcast. Do not assume games are cancelled unless officially posted.
bulletins.author: Safety Director
